description: This file defines an abstract base class for pipeline tasks within a frame processing system. It includes data structures for parameters and core methods for controlling pipeline execution such as starting, stopping, canceling, and queuing frames.

classes.name: PipelineTaskParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for pipeline task execution, primarily including the asyncio event loop.

classes.name: BasePipelineTask
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for managing the lifecycle and execution of pipeline tasks, including methods for starting, stopping, canceling, and queuing frames.

methods.name: bool has_finished(self)
methods.description: Check if the pipeline task has finished execution.

methods.name: stop_when_done(self)
methods.description: Schedule the pipeline to stop after processing all queued frames.

methods.name: cancel(self)
methods.description: Immediately stop the running pipeline, cancel all tasks.

methods.name: run(self, params: PipelineTaskParams)
methods.description: Start and run the pipeline with the provided configuration parameters.

methods.name: queue_frame(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Queue a single frame for processing.

methods.name: queue_frames(self, frames: Iterable[Frame] | AsyncIterable[Frame])
methods.description: Queue multiple frames for processing, accepting an iterable or async iterable.

ctags.name: queue_frames
ctags.pattern: /^    async def queue_frames(self, frames: Iterable[Frame] | AsyncIterable[Frame]):$/
